rv.q: Fifteen years after its Broadway debut, The Book of Mormon remains one of the funniest musicals ever written.
This cast makes it all look so fun.
The cast is great, especially understudy Rayna J. who played Nabulungi on June 2nd, her strong beautiful voice working perfectly in the goofy ballads given to her.
The cast is full of skilled singers, like Charity Arianna (Nabulungi), as well as talented comedic actors, such as Jacob Aune (Cunningham).

cn.t: The irreverent satire remains shocking and hilarious 15 years later, delivering catchy tunes and pointed social commentary beneath its outrageous humor, though its deliberately problematic depiction of religion and Africa still courts controversy.
